sources_quoted.quote: Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.
At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence, increasing her ability power by 15%.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.

Active: Syndra conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones. Afterwards, she barrages the target enemy champion with all collected Dark Spheres, each dealing magic damage upon hit.
Magic Damage per Sphere 80/120/160 (+20% AP); Minimum Magic Damage 240/360/480 (+60% AP); Maximum Magic Damage 560/840/1120 (+140% AP)
Passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to an amount of ability haste. Ability Haste 10/20/30
Q cooldown 7/7/7/7/7 (affectedByCdr false, rechargeRate [7,7,7,7,7], castTime none); W 12/11/10/9/8 (castTime none); E 15 (castTime 0.25); R 120/100/80 (castTime 0.25)

R reads Magic Damage per Sphere x user-set sphere count.'
src/calculator/damage.py computes a rotation from a DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER (fixed Q,W,E,R) ... The event order shown in the UI comes from the fight's cast_order + breakdown damage_events.

Ability recasts are scheduled on one shared timeline (the champion has one set of hands): each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed and no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts) ... the shared-timeline version is the superposition with mutual-exclusion, resolved greedily by cast order.

independent_computation.step_1_decode_the_scenario_name: The trailing '120' is Syndra's Splinters-of-Wrath option at its cap: the passive stacks 'up to 120 times' and 120 is the Transcendence capstone threshold (S1, S2). The audit inventory confirms the option is exactly a 0-120 splinters knob (S8). So the scenario runs Syndra at maximum splinters, which turns on every Transcendent bonus: Q's 2nd charge at 40, W true damage at 60, E scatter at 80, R execute at 100 (documented not modeled), +15% AP at 120.
independent_computation.step_2_how_many_casts_are_in_the_opening: At >=40 splinters Dark Sphere is a 2-charge ability (S3), which the module carries as the synthetic slot Q2 (S8). At splinters=120 the castable damage slots are therefore Q, Q2, W, E, R -> five casts. All five are off cooldown at fight start, and their sourced cast times are 0, 0, 0, 0.25, 0.25 (S7), so under the shared-timeline scheduler (S10) all five start inside the first ~0.5 s with no cooldown wait. Indices 0..4 of cast_timeline are exactly those five slots; index 4 is the LAST cast of the opening rotation.
independent_computation.step_3_when_would_a_6th_cast_land: The first repeat is Dark Sphere: base cd 7 s, and R's passive grants Dark Sphere 10/20/30 ability haste (S6), so at R rank 3 the effective cd is 7 * 100/(100+30) = 5.3846 s (haste identity cd' = cd*100/(100+AH), docs/math-foundations.md formula-audit table). W returns at 8 s, E at 15 s, R is single-cast per the model. So nothing can preempt the opening five, and no repeat can appear before index 5.
independent_computation.step_4_which_slot_must_occupy_the_last_i: Unleashed Power 'conjures 3 Dark Spheres and additionally grabs up to 4 nearby live ones ... each dealing magic damage upon hit' (S4). The leveling rows prove the damage is strictly proportional to the live-sphere count: per-sphere 80/120/160 (+20% AP), minimum = per-sphere x 3 = 240/360/480 (+60% AP), maximum = per-sphere x 7 = 560/840/1120 (+140% AP) (S5; verified arithmetically: 160*3=480, 160*7=1120, 20%*3=60%, 20%*7=140%). Both Dark Sphere charges therefore have to be spent BEFORE R, so that their spheres (ground duration 6 s) are alive to be grabbed. A Dark Sphere cast placed AFTER Unleashed Power contributes nothing to R -- it is the one ordering that provably destroys damage, and it is not how the ability is played. The correct rotation at 120 splinters is {Q, Q2, W, E} in some order, then R last: index 4 = R = 'Unleashed Power'.
independent_computation.step_5_diagnosis_of_the_old_value: 'Dark Sphere' at index 4 means the last cast of the five-slot rotation was a Dark Sphere and Unleashed Power sat at index <= 3 -- i.e. the synthetic second-charge slot Q2 was appended to the tail of the cast order (after R) instead of riding with its parent Q, which is both unplayable and strictly damage-negative by step 4. Under the alternative reading in which Q2 is not modeled at all, the rotation would be only four casts (Q,W,E,R) and index 4 would be the cooldown-gated Q repeat at t = 5.3846 s -- also 'Dark Sphere', and also wrong, because S3 + S8 say the second charge exists at 120 splinters and must be inside the opening rotation. Both routes to the old value are refuted by the same sources.
independent_computation.conclusion: The fifth entry (index 4) of the opening cast timeline for Syndra at 120 splinters is Unleashed Power. The new value is correct.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario's literal custom cast_order list lives in scripts/tests, which this oracle is barred from reading. The computation above does not depend on the permutation of the non-ultimate slots: for any order that keeps R last -- which every damage-correct order must, by S4/S5 -- the five-slot rotation at 120 splinters puts Unleashed Power at index 4. The verdict would only flip if the scenario deliberately specified an R-before-Q order, which the wiki text shows is a strictly worse and non-canonical rotation.
